div.head: Northu 67.1
div.ab: ⁊ we willað, þæt landceap ⁊ lahceap ⁊ witword ⁊ getrywe gewitnes ⁊ riht dom ⁊ fulloc ⁊ frumtalu fæste stande ⁊ dryncelean ⁊ hlafordes rihtgifu, ⁊ huru an Cristendom ⁊ an cynedom æfre on ðeode.

And we willað þæt landceap and lahceap and witword and getrywe gewitnes and riht dom and fulloc and frumtalu fæste stande, and dryncelean and hlafordes rihtgifu, and huru an Cristendom and an cynedom æfre on ðeode.

And it is our will, that the purchase of land and the purchase of legal rights and agreements and trustworthy witness, and just judgment and final settlement and first statement of a case [?] are to remain valid, and drincelean and the lord’s legal gift, and above all ever one Christianity and one royal authority in the nation.

And we ordain that land transactions, legal fines, sworn statements, honest testimony, just judgments, final settlements, and initial claims are to remain binding, likewise negotiated settlements, the lord’s lawful gift, and most of all one Christian faith and one kingdom in the realm forever.

Und wir wollen, dass Kauf von Grund und Boden und Erkaufung des Rechtsschutzes und Vertrag und vertrauenswürdiges Zeugniss und rechtes Urtheil und voll abschliessende Abmachung[?] und gerichtliche Aussage[? oder Verabredung?] fest gelte und ‘Trinklohn’ [Vertragschluss oder Nordisch: Landverleihung für Bewirtung] und gesetzliche Schenkung durch einen Herrn, und namentlich Ein Christenthum und Ein Königthum stets im Lande.

And we will that purchase of land and purchase of legal protection and agreement and trustworthy witness and right judgment and full settlement[?] and formal statement in court[? or agreement?] shall stand firm, and ‘drink-reward’ [conclusion of a contract, or in Norse usage a grant of land for hospitality] and a lord's lawful gift, and above all one Christianity and one kingship always among the people.

div.note: Liebermann compares III Atr 3, II Cn 81, and Northu 47 and 67 above.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘And it is our will, that the purchase of land and the purchase of legal rights and agreements and trustworthy witness, and just judgement and final settlement and the first statement of a case [?] are to remain valid, and drinclean and the lord's legal gift, and above all ever one Christianity and one royal authority in the nation.’).
This is a combination of III Ethclred, 3 and II Cnut, 81.
This term, fulloc, occurs here only.
Another unique word, Jrumtalu. It may mean that the accuser is not allowed to change his charge later.

legal fines: Literally, “law business,” a compound referring to the payment of a fine by an outlaw to regain his legal status. negotiated contracts: See note to 2 Cnut 81 above. Blessed . . . and forever: Psalms 112:2. The Obligations of Individuals and On Reeves
